spec.description: Betula Sync's service, Phloem (docs/phloem/protocol.md): what it holds and does (the devices' connections between each other, and what is shared, among it), read from the file it writes (it shares no network with the monitoring), and whether it is still kept apart: its firewall and rights as betula-phloem-guard sees them from outside. Provisioned from deploy/config/monitoring/grafana/dashboards - edit there.

spec.title: Phloem
spec.description: phloem_up of each instance, from its stats file (Phloem shares no network with the monitoring: it writes /run/betula/phloem/<stack>/stats/phloem.prom, Alloy reads it). The last file a stopping Phloem writes says 0; a file that stops changing is a Phloem that stopped too (next panel).

spec.title: Age of the stats file
spec.description: Phloem writes it every 15 s. Older than 2 minutes: rule "Phloem: not running".

spec.title: Spaces
spec.description: Profiles that sync (phloem_spaces), and of them those with a device online.

spec.title: Devices and sockets
spec.description: Devices with a slot in a space, and the WebSockets open now.

spec.title: Budget used
spec.description: What all spaces hold (phloem_bytes) of the budget (phloem_budget_bytes): at 100 % no new space and no parcel is taken, the old spaces go on. Past half: rule "Phloem: past half of its budget".

spec.title: Its filesystem
spec.description: /var/lib/betula/phloem/<stack>/data on the host, a filesystem of fixed size of its own: Phloem fills nothing but itself.

spec.title: Pushes and snapshots
spec.description: Changes kept (entries) and snapshots kept, per second.

spec.title: Bytes coming in
spec.description: Sealed bytes of the pushes and snapshots kept, per second.

spec.title: Spaces made and deleted, per hour
spec.description: Made: "Betula Sync" switched on. Deleted: "Sync beenden", or untouched for 395 days. Phloem takes at most 500 new spaces an hour (20 per address); past 250: rule "Phloem: many spaces made".

spec.title: Refused, by reason
spec.description: Requests and frames Phloem refused: unauthorized, too_big, compact_first, slow_down, full, budget, exists, origin, busy, invalid.

spec.title: Sockets that ended, by reason
spec.description: left, gone, replaced, restart, slow, timeout, lost, invalid, internal.

spec.title: Release
spec.description: phloem_build_info: the version and build (the start of the sha256 of the executable) of each instance.

spec.title: Its firewall
spec.description: betula_phloem_guard_firewall: every running container of the stack has the table inet phloem in its network namespace (vps/files/betula-phloem-guard.sh, every minute as root, from outside the container). No: rule "Phloem: its firewall or its rights are not as they should be".

spec.title: Rights
spec.description: betula_phloem_guard_privileged: a process of its container runs as root or holds a capability. "phloem start" sets the firewall and drops to uid 65532 without capabilities before it serves.

spec.title: The guard looked
spec.description: Seconds since betula-phloem-guard last wrote its file (it runs every minute).

spec.title: What its firewall dropped
spec.description: Packets the counting drop rules of table inet phloem dropped, per chain, in 5 minutes. output: Phloem (or something in its container) tried to open a connection; input: something knocked on a port other than 8200. 91-verify-stacks.sh (sections netmatrix and phloem) makes such drops on purpose with its probes.

spec.title: Requests through Traefik, by code
spec.description: The routers of /sync/v1/ (the stacks phloem and phloem-canary; the WebSocket is one request).

spec.title: Turned away by Traefik
spec.description: 429 from the middleware sync-ratelimit (20 requests a second per address, bursts of 60) before anything reaches Phloem.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Of the containers of the stacks phloem and phloem-canary (cAdvisor in Alloy).

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Working set of the containers of the stacks phloem and phloem-canary.

spec.title: TURN allocations
spec.description: Relays Phloem's TURN holds now (phloem_turn_allocations): two devices that found no direct way talk through one of them. 0 most of the time; at most PHLOEM_MAX_RELAYS per instance.

spec.title: Relayed now
spec.description: Bytes per second the TURN relays pass, both ways (phloem_relay_bytes_total): changes of a profile between two of its devices, small. A steady stream means a device sends what is no change (each relay has its rate, beyond which it drops).

spec.title: Devices over HTTPS
spec.description: Devices whose socket goes over plain HTTPS (phloem_poll_sessions, since Phloem 0.4.0): where a network lets no WebSocket through, the same frames by POST and GET of /sync/v1/poll. They count among the sockets too.

spec.title: Signals, last hour
spec.description: Signals Phloem handed from one device to another of its space in the last hour (phloem_signals_total): offers, answers and candidates that set up a direct connection, sealed with the profile's key (Phloem reads none of them).

spec.title: TURN turned away, last hour
spec.description: Requests TURN refused in the last hour: refused (a peer that is no other device of the space), unauthorized (a credential that is wrong or old), quota (more allocations than a socket may hold), no_port (every relay port in use), nonce (a nonce not handed to the address). A few are normal (an old credential after a reconnect); many unauthorized or refused mean someone tries the relays.

spec.title: Relayed where it must not
spec.description: Datagrams a relay was to send to an address no device of its space came from, in the last day (phloem_turn_total{event=forbidden}): dropped, and it must never happen. The alert "Phloem: a relay was to send where no peer may be" fires on it.

spec.title: TURN, by event
spec.description: What TURN did, per second: allocated (a relay for a socket), permitted (a peer let through: another device of the space), learned (an allocation came from another address than its socket, a phone on a VPN or IPv6), and the refusals of "TURN turned away".

spec.title: Bytes relayed, by way
spec.description: Bytes per second the relays passed (in: from a peer, out: to a peer), and those they dropped beyond their rates (phloem_relay_dropped_bytes_total).

spec.title: Signals handed on
spec.description: Signals for WebRTC per second (phloem_signals_total): every attempt of two devices to connect directly sends a few; their rate per device is limited.

spec.title: The socket over HTTPS
spec.description: Poll sessions opened per second, and those that ended by reason (closed: with a close the device hears; lost: without one; slow: too far behind; idle: nobody asked for a minute).

spec.title: Parts kept
spec.description: Parts of shared calendars and lists that stay current (phloem_parts): each sealed with a key of its own that Phloem never sees; at most 32 per space.

spec.title: Parts watched
spec.description: Parts that open sockets watch (phloem_parts_watched): a device that follows a shared calendar or list hears of each new version at once.

spec.title: Parts read, last hour
spec.description: Reads of parts in the last hour, answered 200 or 304 (phloem_parts_total{event=served|not_modified}): devices that follow, and Folia for calendar subscriptions that stay current. Folia's reads share one address and its limit of 3600 an hour.

spec.title: Parcels taken, last day
spec.description: Parcels opened in the last day (phloem_parcels_total{event=taken}): one-time links of shared calendars and lists, and the parcels that bring a profile to another device.

spec.title: Parts, by event
spec.description: What became of parts, per second: put (made or replaced: the sharer's device renews a part when what it shares changes), deleted (Nicht mehr teilen, or with their space), served and not_modified (reads), missed and gone (reads of no such part, 404, and of one deleted, 410).

spec.title: Parcels, by event
spec.description: Parcels per second, by event: left (a one-time link made, or a profile on its way to another device), taken, missed (asked for and not there), expired, withdrawn (Zurückziehen).

spec.title: Between devices: directly, through TURN, over HTTPS
Sync
